store_info.description_short: Build your personal knowledge base with Trilium Notes
store_info.description_long: Trilium Notes is an open-source, cross-platform hierarchical note taking application with focus on building large personal knowledge bases.
hint: Updating an existing installation from v0.95 migrates the database one way. The built-in AI/LLM integration was removed in v0.102, and downgrading after the migration requires restoring a backup.
Backend scripting and the SQL console are disabled by default since v0.104.
